status: proposed technical design choices; no owner outcome or admission

choices.title: Three responsibilities
choices.choice: Capture/normalize, construct/check, export/handoff; preserve semantic record distinctions without a prescribed module tree.

choices.title: Concrete adapter
choices.choice: One exact local successor installation; historical bundle input is not a fallback live backend.

choices.title: Separate host successor
choices.choice: Rebind complete source/schema/profile/import/authority closure; do not patch frozen API17 or bypass exact Service type checks.

choices.title: Native pre-stage core recipe
choices.choice: Host stager constructs exact metadata/target/custody/core bytes before existing native independent validation.

choices.title: Current scoped preparation permission
choices.choice: Successor authentication and routing verify actual selected principal/key/scope/cohort/period and native authority basis, never the historical fixture document.

choices.title: Persistent exact retained closure
choices.choice: Root R plus exact members and immutable completion receipt; one Lab scope per independently selected retained store.

choices.title: Existing carriers plus closed resolver
choices.choice: Source pins R and completion receipt D; Evidence Set/Work refs resolve through explicitly registered carrier fields and actual target/standing checks.

choices.title: Bytes before governing links
choices.choice: Complete custody before Source/Work targets and actual governing commit; rejection leaves unlinked retained bytes.

choices.title: Preparation versus subsequent use
choices.choice: Frozen readiness is historical; separate use observation cannot authorize changed input/use/payload/meaning.

choices.title: Live acceptance and legacy boundaries
choices.choice: Fixture core work may precede actual host integration; existing commands/numeric compile remain original; new Pack compile unsupported.
